data.name: Drawn into Darkness
data.detailed_description:
The Darkness Beckons...

"Welcome to the Darkness friend. Drawn here of your own will, to slay the denizens that have claimed these halls through blood and bone. You descend these stairs, in pursuit of riches and power, a fool's gamble of course. Beware, Hero as the light above whimpers at the foul beasts that lay below, longing to chew and claw your insides again and again...

Come, wander these rooms and meet me at the bottom if you can, Hero..."

So Forge your Path

Drawn into Darkness is a Dark Fantasy Deckbuilding Roguelite where you crawl through the depths of a long forgotten Dungeon, charting a path through each floor one room at a time. During your descent, you'll be claiming treasures, uncovering hidden lore, bandaging your wounds, and battling the ferocious denizens that call these halls home. 

Featuring 100 randomly generated Dungeon Floors, 200 Core Cards and 8 Classes.  Choose your path wisely friend, for it's a long way down...

Built by Humans, for Humans

Earthborn Entertainment will never use AI generated content in our games, and we limit research using AI to as little as possible to maintain our integrity, save valuable water resources. We believe corporations who put profits over planet and people should be used as little as possible, and aim to give back when and where we can.

Our Human-first approach to game development will never be bought out, or corrupted. We will never use AI generated art, text, descriptions, story or programmed features in our games for any reason. Everything is a hand crafted experience, from keyboard strokes to paint on canvas. 

We hope you enjoy your experiences with us, as there will be many more to come!

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
